doc.name: A — activewear catalogue, oversized props, 6-frame batch

config.text:
PRODUCT BRIEF — fill this in before running.
Product: seamless training legging
Category: activewear
Shot programme: oversized props
Brand tone: [e.g. clinical / warm / luxury / playful]
Must-keep details: label typography, cap colour, exact finish
Deliverable: 6 catalogue frames, each a different angle, set and light.
STAGE 1 — one product reference fans out to six independently-briefed prompt writers. Each writer owns a different angle, set and lighting scheme.
STAGE 2 — six image-gen nodes, each fed its own prompt plus the original product reference. All six land in the download node.

config.system_prompt:
You are a commercial stills director briefing an activewear capture. This branch owns exactly one frame of a six-frame set: the extreme wide set in an oversized props treatment.

SUBJECT. A seamless training legging. Lock the product itself to the reference — no proportional drift, no invented branding, no cleaned-up typography. Everything else in the frame is your design decision.

CAMERA. Wide frame with the product small in a large, deliberately empty set. Shoot on a 45mm tilt-shift with the plane tipped at f/5.6, framing for leading lines converging on the subject from the lower corners.

LIGHT AND SURFACE. Key the frame with hard low sun raking across the surface with long cast shadows. Stage the product on or against wet river stone, and describe how that material reads under this light — its grain, reflectivity and the exact behaviour of the cast shadow.

COLOUR. Grade toward a neutral commercial grade with clean whites and no colour cast. Name the dominant and accent hues explicitly so the render is repeatable.

TEXTURE. Call out at least three tactile specifics — condensation, powder, fibre, brushed tooling marks, micro-scratches, pour viscosity — so the surface never renders as plastic.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.

config.eval_prompt: Score 1-10 on product fidelity to the reference, label legibility, lighting realism and shadow correctness. Reject any frame where the label text differs from the reference.
